LESSON: READING 8.2.1 INTENSIVE READING

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 8
Topic 8.2: Reading 8.2.1 Intensive Reading
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 8.2.1 Intensive Reading, part of Strand 8 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade seven ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How can you identify the message in a poem?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 8.2.1 Intensive Reading together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
 Digital Literacy is enhanced as the learner creates a word puzzle and shares it online using digital devices.

 Critical thinking and problem solving are developed as the learner relates issues highlighted in poems and to real life.

Values:
Respect is enhanced as the learner respects the opinion of others as they utilise digital devices to check the meanings of words.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs)

Peace is enhanced as the learner works in groups to evaluate issues highlighted in poems.

Link to other subjects:

 The learner relates the concept of moral lessons learnt to other learning areas such as Social Studies.
